implementation_kind.label: FPGA (HDL)
implementation_kind.description: Reimplementation as synthesizable hardware description (Verilog, VHDL, etc.) run on an FPGA, reproducing the original chip's behavior in hardware logic rather than by interpreting or recompiling instructions.

implementation_kind.label: Original silicon
implementation_kind.description: The genuine part itself, or a pin- and behavior-compatible respin fabricated as an ASIC, used in place of any emulation or reimplementation.

implementation_kind.label: Software emulation
implementation_kind.description: Reproduction of the chip's behavior by software running on a general-purpose CPU (interpretation, dynamic recompilation, or a cycle model), with no dedicated hardware logic involved.
